import type { ToolFamily } from '../types'

// One soft dark palette, shared by the text views and the city.
export const C = {
  bg: '#14161c',
  ground: '#1c2029',
  tile: '#232834',
  tileEdge: '#2b3140',
  road: '#2b3140',
  roadMark: '#3a4254',
  text: '#c9cfdb',
  muted: '#7b8496',
  faint: '#4a5263',
  done: '#8fbf9f',
  run: '#e0c38c',
  agent: '#8ea6e0',
  fail: '#d98c9a',
  skill: '#b39ddb',
  proc: '#7fc8c2',
} as const

export const FAMILIES: readonly ToolFamily[] = [
  'search',
  'read',
  'edit',
  'shell',
  'web',
  'mcp',
  'skill',
  'delegate',
  'plan',
  'other',
]

export const FAMILY_LABEL: Record<ToolFamily, string> = {
  search: 'search',
  read: 'read',
  edit: 'edit',
  shell: 'shell',
  web: 'web',
  mcp: 'connectors',
  skill: 'skills',
  delegate: 'delegate',
  plan: 'plan',
  other: 'other',
}

// What a tool badge reads as where no icon can be drawn.
export const FAMILY_GLYPH: Record<ToolFamily, string> = {
  search: '⌕',
  read: '▤',
  edit: '✎',
  shell: '❯',
  web: '◍',
  mcp: '⧉',
  skill: '✦',
  delegate: '⇄',
  plan: '☰',
  other: '·',
}

export const FAMILY_COLOR: Record<ToolFamily, string> = {
  search: C.proc,
  read: C.agent,
  edit: C.run,
  shell: C.done,
  web: C.proc,
  mcp: C.skill,
  skill: C.skill,
  delegate: C.agent,
  plan: C.muted,
  other: C.muted,
}

const FAMILY_OF: { [tool: string]: ToolFamily } = {
  Read: 'read',
  Grep: 'search',
  Glob: 'search',
  ToolSearch: 'search',
  Edit: 'edit',
  Write: 'edit',
  NotebookEdit: 'edit',
  Bash: 'shell',
  PowerShell: 'shell',
  Monitor: 'shell',
  TaskStop: 'shell',
  WebFetch: 'web',
  WebSearch: 'web',
  Skill: 'skill',
  Agent: 'delegate',
  Workflow: 'delegate',
  SendMessage: 'delegate',
  TodoWrite: 'plan',
  TaskCreate: 'plan',
  TaskUpdate: 'plan',
  TaskList: 'plan',
  TaskGet: 'plan',
  EnterPlanMode: 'plan',
  ExitPlanMode: 'plan',
  AskUserQuestion: 'plan',
}

export const familyOf = (tool: string): ToolFamily =>
  tool.startsWith('mcp__') ? 'mcp' : (FAMILY_OF[tool] ?? 'other')

export type AgentLook = { color: string; glyph: string; icon: string }

const LOOKS: { [type: string]: AgentLook } = {
  main: { color: C.agent, glyph: '◆', icon: 'a-main' },
  Explore: { color: C.proc, glyph: '◎', icon: 'a-explore' },
  Plan: { color: C.skill, glyph: '▧', icon: 'a-plan' },
  worker: { color: C.run, glyph: '⚒', icon: 'a-worker' },
  verifier: { color: C.done, glyph: '✓', icon: 'a-verifier' },
  'general-purpose': { color: C.agent, glyph: '●', icon: 'a-general' },
  claude: { color: C.agent, glyph: '●', icon: 'a-general' },
}

const SPARE = [C.agent, C.proc, C.skill, C.run, C.done]

// A plugin's agent type is `<plugin>:<name>`: its look goes by the name.
export const lookOf = (type: string): AgentLook => {
  const short = type.includes(':') ? type.slice(type.lastIndexOf(':') + 1) : type
  const known = LOOKS[short]
  if (known !== undefined) return known
  let hash = 0
  for (const char of short) hash = (hash * 31 + char.charCodeAt(0)) % 9973

  return { color: SPARE[hash % SPARE.length] ?? C.agent, glyph: '●', icon: 'a-general' }
}

export const VIEWS = [
  { name: 'overview', label: 'Overview' },
  { name: 'city', label: 'City' },
  { name: 'tasks', label: 'Tasks' },
  { name: 'agents', label: 'Agents' },
  { name: 'resources', label: 'Resources' },
  { name: 'skills', label: 'Skills' },
] as const
files.types/index.d.ts:
export type TaskStatus = 'pending' | 'in_progress' | 'completed'

export type Task = {
  id: string
  subject: string
  status: TaskStatus
  activeForm?: string
  /** The work area the task belongs to: its district on the map. */
  area: string
  /** The task this one is a sub-task of. */
  parentId?: string
  owner?: string
  /** The subagent loop that recorded it; absent for the main loop's. */
  agentId?: string
  blockedBy: string[]
  source: 'task' | 'todo'
}

export type ToolFamily =
  | 'search'
  | 'read'
  | 'edit'
  | 'shell'
  | 'web'
  | 'mcp'
  | 'skill'
  | 'delegate'
  | 'plan'
  | 'other'

export type FamilyCounts = { [family: string]: number }

export type AgentRunStatus = 'starting' | 'running' | 'done' | 'failed'

export type AgentRun = {
  key: string
  agentId?: string
  parentAgentId?: string
  label: string
  type: string
  name?: string
  model?: string
  status: AgentRunStatus
  tools: number
  /** Tool calls by family: what the agent is equipped with on its icon. */
  families: FamilyCounts
  lastTool?: string
  /** The task the agent is working on, when one could be matched. */
  taskId?: string
  tokens: number
  startedAt: number
  endedAt?: number
}

export type ProcKind = 'shell' | 'monitor' | 'workflow' | 'cron' | 'agent' | 'other'

export type ProcStatus = 'running' | 'done' | 'stopped'

export type Proc = {
  id: string
  kind: ProcKind
  label: string
  status: ProcStatus
  startedAt: number
  endedAt?: number
}

export type Size = 'S' | 'M' | 'L' | 'XL'

export type Range = { low: number; high: number }

export type Expected = {
  size: Size
  source: 'heuristic' | 'model'
  tokens: Range
  ms: Range
  tools: Range
  /** How many past turns of this size the ranges were drawn from. */
  samples: number
}

export type Turn = {
  id: string | null
  isWorking: boolean
  startedAt: number
  endedAt: number
  expected: Expected | null
  /** Tokens processed this turn: uncached input, cache writes and output. */
  tokens: number
  outTokens: number
  cacheRead: number
  tools: number
  steps: number
  agents: number
  hasWarned: boolean
}

export type RateLimit = { kind: string; percentUsed: number; resetsAt?: string }

export type Usage = {
  contextTokens: number
  contextWindow: number
  contextPercent: number
  rateLimits: RateLimit[]
  costUsd: number
  sessionTokens: number
  mainFamilies: FamilyCounts
  hasWarnedContext: boolean
}

export type TurnRecord = {
  size: Size
  tokens: number
  ms: number
  tools: number
  agents: number
  at: number
}

export type MilestoneStatus = 'planned' | 'active' | 'done'

export type Milestone = { id: string; title: string; status: MilestoneStatus }

export type Project = {
  root: string
  name: string
  phase: string
  milestones: Milestone[]
  sessions: number
  lastSessionId: string
  turns: number
  tokens: number
  tasksDone: number
  lastActive: number
}

export type SkillInfo = { name: string; description: string; source: string }

export type Skills = {
  available: SkillInfo[]
  used: { [name: string]: number }
  suggested: string[]
}

export type ViewName = 'overview' | 'city' | 'tasks' | 'agents' | 'resources' | 'skills'

export type Ui = { view: ViewName; isBandHidden: boolean; hasOpened: boolean }

export type Activity = { at: number; kind: string; text: string }

export type FileHit = { path: string; edits: number }

declare module 'claude-code' {
  interface McpToolInputs {
    mcp__polis__project: {
      name?: string
      phase?: string
      milestones?: { id: string; title?: string; status?: MilestoneStatus }[]
      tasks?: {
        id: string
        subject?: string
        status?: TaskStatus | 'deleted'
        area?: string
        parent?: string
        owner?: string
        blockedBy?: string[]
        activeForm?: string
      }[]
    }
  }
  interface PluginState {
    polis: {
      tasks: Task[]
      agents: AgentRun[]
      procs: Proc[]
      turn: Turn
      usage: Usage
      history: TurnRecord[]
      project: Project | null
      skills: Skills
      ui: Ui
      activity: Activity[]
      files: FileHit[]
      tick: number
    }
  }
}
